rationale:
The defect is a missing end anchor on the first alternative of the V8 URL location regex in lib/src/frame.dart: `^(.*?):(\d+)(?::(\d+))?|native$`. Because the alternative is unanchored and `(.*?)` is lazy, a URI containing a port stops matching at the authority colon, so `http://localhost:8080/stuff.dart.js:560:28` parses as uri `http://localhost` with line 8080 instead of uri `http://localhost:8080/stuff.dart.js`, line 560, column 28. The fix adds `$` to that alternative, which is exactly the behavior asserted by the trigger test 'parses a stack frame with a : in the authority' and exactly what the PR/commit subject and issue #69 describe ('Fix parsing for URIs with a : in the authority'). The pre-existing nature is confirmed by the strict gates: trigger.buggy_differential reproduces that selector alone on the buggy revision, trigger.fixed_clean and full_suite.fixed_all_green pass on the fixed revision, and determinism held over 3 repetitions in a 38-run matrix. The minimized production patch touches only lib/src/frame.dart and contains one behavioral line (the regex) plus one inert comment line whose example URL was refreshed on the construct being changed; there is no refactor, feature extension, config, or test content in the production patch, and the test hunk is isolated in patches/trigger-tests.patch. The trigger uses the pre-existing public `Frame.parseV8` API with no API introduced by the fix, so it runs unmodified against the buggy revision. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and dart-archive/stack_trace#69 is the sole allowed verified issue key, reached via traceability path fix_commit_to_merged_pr_to_issue.

The fix adds `$` to the first alternative (`...(?::(\d+))?$|native$`), forcing a full-string match. That is exactly the behavior described by the fix commit / PR #69 ('Fix parsing for URIs with a : in the authority'), which traceability verifies as linked to issue 69, and exactly what the trigger asserts: parseV8 of a frame with `http://localhost:8080/...` must yield uri `http://localhost:8080/stuff.dart.js`, line 560, column 28. The minimized production patch touches only the one regex line plus the adjacent comment example inside the same hunk; there is no refactor, API change, config, or test content in it, and the accompanying test change is isolated in patches/trigger-tests.patch. The trigger is the unchanged upstream test from the fixing commit and calls only the pre-existing public `Frame.parseV8` API (used by neighboring pre-fix tests in the same group), so it introduces no dependency on a new production API. The pre-existing selector 'parses a stack frame correctly' passes on the buggy revision while only the new selector fails, confirming the trigger isolates a pre-existing defect rather than a new feature. Strict evidence gates pass in both the original and post-minimization runs (build.both_versions, trigger.buggy_differential with reproduced selector test/frame_test.dart::'parses a stack frame with a : in the authority', trigger.fixed_clean, trigger.deterministic with 3 fingerprint groups, full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers, full_suite.fixed_all_green, matrix.complete runs=38 at 3 repetitions), with no failed checks. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and dart-archive/stack_trace#69 is in allowed_root_cause_ids, so the root cause is not a duplicate.
